contract.intent: Amend tree-format-spec v2 (locked @ 257cb79) to v3: add the resolution mechanism — structured event fields (artifact-locked carries logical name + path + lock sha; superseded carries successor) and the derived current(name) resolution rule. Produces a COMPLETE superseding artifact (change-protocol §3).
acceptanceCriteria: tree-format-spec-v3.md artifact exists — complete doc = v2 content + the resolution mechanism
Event schema structured: artifact-locked events carry {name, path, lockSha}; superseded events carry {successor: {name, path}}; missing/unknown fields rejected
Resolution rule stated: current(name) = latest artifact-locked with that name whose producer is not superseded — derived at read time, never stored; one current per name (validator)
Durable references = logical name + stable section anchor; anchors never renumber (validator); forward pointers on superseded
Resolution verification: file exists, event matches path+name, not superseded — else fail-closed validation error
Engine AC added (F-AC13): resolver returns the correct current artifact per logical name
v3 locked (type=spec); v2 gets a superseded event; AGENTS.md/README/cards point at v3
requiredInputs: Grilled decision (this session): correct path is stored in events as a fact; current is derived
